scripts.install:all: cd mwd-app-be && npm install && cd ../mwd-app-fe && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix mwd-app-be run dev" "npm --prefix mwd-app-fe run dev"
scripts.dev:port-3001: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix mwd-app-be run dev" "npm --prefix mwd-app-fe run dev:port-3001"
scripts.setup:local: npm --prefix mwd-app-be run prisma:generate && npm --prefix mwd-app-be run prisma:migrate && npm --prefix mwd-app-be run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix mwd-app-be run build && npm --prefix mwd-app-fe run build
scripts.start:local: npm run build && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix mwd-app-be run start" "npm --prefix mwd-app-fe run start:port-3001"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix mwd-app-be run start" "npm --prefix mwd-app-fe run start"
